testing_rules: All interactive elements must include a testID attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid)
instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo project. Do NOT use DOM elements like <div> or <span>. Use <View>, <Text>, <TouchableOpacity>.
Strictly follow the color palette. No other colors are allowed.
Implement navigation using React Navigation, but standard screens are minimal. Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for all modals.
Use react-native-reanimated for the 400ms ease-in-out transitions. No spring/bouncy animations.
Use expo-haptics on every user interaction.
Use expo-font to load Cormorant Garamond, Scheherazade New, Inter, and Great Vibes.
Use react-native-svg for all icons and the background patterns. Do not use PNGs or emojis.
